Input image 2 is the approved character identity and clean hand-drawn style. Redraw the source artwork in that style, with genuine line and color work instead of retouching or filtering. Keep game-original characters unchanged.

Layout: 3 columns × 2 rows of equally sized slots, each figure isolated in its own slot. Exactly the poses below in row-major order, no duplicates or added images. Align poses with the same silhouette, proportions, body lean, limb angles and eyes as input 1. Leave fully transparent gutters between all panels. Keep all full-body silhouettes complete, with tips of head, paws/flippers, toes and ankles intact. No sheets' heading, layout lines, numbering, swatches, border or extra silhouette. Outer gutters and spaces inside silhouettes true transparent RGBA. No ground plane, ground shadows, vignette, checkerboard printed into pixels, props except those stated, no text, no stickers, no glow.

Frame requirements: Match all six source positions, exactly 3 × 2: row 1 ready with paws apart, crouch toward floor, inactive waiting reference pose with paws at chest; row 2 lean up with arms rising, two-paw thrust forward, settle low on all fours. Same positions and expressions. The runtime uses the ready, crouch, lift, thrust and settle tiles. No watery effects, no droplets.

Identity: exactly the same yellow banana-suit cat, brown short bent peeled stem, tan-brown tabby face and shallow whisker strokes, small dark paws/feet, natural yellow pull of the banana suit. Match pose source expressions, same head and limb proportions. In input 2 the tears are an identity example only: outside a tiny natural eye detail stated above, NEVER render any blue water, tear jet or effects.

Rendering: high-definition hand-drawn 2D cartoon. Decisive clean warm-dark outline with artist-like stroke variation, matte color blocks, one or two simple painted cel shadows, faint subtle brush finish inside broad fills, crisp at normal game size. Honor source colors and clean edge clarity. No pixel art, no steppy pixelation, no blur, no digital glow, no fake vector sheen, no heavy grain, no realism.
